content: Oracle treats '' and NULL as identical in storage/comparison/NOT NULL constraints/concatenation; PostgreSQL treats them as distinct (empty string passes NOT NULL, comparisons with NULL yield NULL not TRUE, concatenation with NULL yields NULL not the other operand contrary to Oracle). Migration must explicitly decide per-column whether '' should become NULL on load, and add CHECK constraints or triggers if Oracle-like NOT NULL behavior on empty string is required. orafce NVL() helps but does not fix comparison/concatenation semantics.
